timing: Post-target amendment after the single-page power result and review request. No original search, score, crib, recurrence, or null rule is changed.
arms: Exactly the 12 frozen single-page positive-control arms: sub/add/beaufort crossed with recurrence order 2–5, same seeds and coefficients.
search: For each arm, enumerate all 13 original corrected-search cribs, three modes and all positions leaving 128 runes on the planted page; combine with the same complete search on all ten unchanged LP2 pages. success: The true candidate recovers all 128 known post-crib runes exactly and ranks first across all 11 slots, with tied candidates separately counted.
control_scope: This is a clean-message detection-power check at 226 runes, not a target-page replacement or a calibrated LP2 null. The original 199 shuffle maxima used the original 273-rune LP2-11 slot and are descriptive only for this mixed grid.
